ov: في الصيف لازم نحب فيلم كوميدي مصري أُصدر عام 1974، من بطولة صلاح ذو الفقار، وإخراج محمد عبد العزيز.
plotEn: Dr. Nabil, a psychiatrist and his orderly take four male patients to a beach resort in Alexandria to help them integrate into the society and overcome their mental illnesses. The four patients meet their new soul mates. Three of the girls are with their very old fashioned and strict father, but finally love combines between every young man and woman, and they agree to get married. This summer trip and love helped Dr. Nabil to treat his patients and cure them from their illness.
